# CCV Research UI – AI Agent Guide

- **Architecture**: Two apps in one repo. Streamlit backend for APC research (services + views) in `backend/`. Next.js 16 frontend portal in `frontend/` with auth, chat UI, and libsql/Drizzle persistence.
- **Run backend**: `cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && streamlit run app.py`. Needs `data/CPT Codes with Long Descriptions 2025.xlsx`; SQLite DBs auto-create under `backend/data/`. Optional check: `python test_refactored_code.py`.
- **Run frontend**: `cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev` (or `build`/`start`). Env vars required: `NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_OKTA_*`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_POST_LOGOUT`, `DB_URL` (path to local sqlite file), Azure OpenAI keys matching backend.
- **LLM config**: Azure model mapping lives in [backend/llm_wrapper.py](../backend/llm_wrapper.py) and [frontend/lib/llm.ts](../frontend/lib/llm.ts). Models `gpt-4.1*`, `gpt-5*`, and `medgemma-27b-multimodal7` (custom URL, no key). Set per-model endpoint/key envs (e.g., `AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY_GPT_5`).
- **Agentic APC workflow**: Prefer per-section runs via `conduct_all_sections_research` / `conduct_section_research` in [backend/services/apc_orchestrator.py](../backend/services/apc_orchestrator.py). Avoid legacy `conduct_comprehensive_research` unless maintaining old flows.
- **Section services**: Section modules (code description, guidelines, payment, device, NCCI, reference) live in `backend/services/`. Each exposes `get_section_metadata()` and section-specific prompt builders; Section 1 uses a full pipeline (`analyze_code_descriptions`) with caching.
- **Caching/output**: Section 1 writes results to `backend/output/services_findings/{cpt}/section_1_results.json` and reuses unless `use_cache=False`. RAG/NCCI retrieval saves to `backend/ncci_rag/output/`.
- **Data utilities**: [backend/services/utils.py](../backend/services/utils.py) handles audit window calculation, CPT description replacement, and all SQLite helpers (notes, chat history, research sessions, accuracy feedback). DB path base: `backend/data/`.
- **CPT descriptions**: Uses `services.common.get_or_generate_cpt_description` (local Excel, optional LLM fallback). When adding code-description logic, reuse this to keep source tagging and avoid duplicate LLM calls.
- **RAG (NCCI)**: [backend/ncci_rag/src/retrieve.py](../backend/ncci_rag/src/retrieve.py) implements multi-stage hybrid retrieval (range routing → policy expansion → BM25+semantic with RRF). Requires Azure embedding env vars (`AZURE_*_EMBEDDING`) and prebuilt indexes from `build_*` scripts under `backend/ncci_rag/src/`.
- **Streamlit UI**: [backend/views/apc_main_view.py](../backend/views/apc_main_view.py) drives the 3-step flow (topic → CPT selection → per-section tabs). Views in `backend/views/` render tabs, chat, feedback, exports; shared UI helpers in [backend/views/utils.py](../backend/views/utils.py). State keys: `apc_step`, `generated_cpts`, `selected_cpt`, `section_chat_history`, etc.
- **Frontend data layer**: [frontend/lib/db.ts](../frontend/lib/db.ts) uses Drizzle with libsql against a file-based DB (`DB_URL`). Supports chat sessions, research sessions, feedback, and message updates; enforces Okta user ownership per operation.
- **Frontend auth/UI**: Okta SPA client in [frontend/lib/okta.ts](../frontend/lib/okta.ts). Chat/LLM calls use the Azure client in [frontend/lib/llm.ts](../frontend/lib/llm.ts); chat types live in [frontend/lib/chat.ts](../frontend/lib/chat.ts). Components/hooks under `frontend/components` and `frontend/hooks` manage chat panes, persona settings, text highlighting.
- **Adding a new research section (backend)**: Create `services/<section>_service.py` with `build_section_prompt`/`run_section` + metadata; add to `SECTION_SERVICES` in `apc_orchestrator.py`; build matching view renderer in `views/<section>_view.py`; wire tab label lookup via `SECTION_SERVICES` in `apc_main_view.py`.
- **Styling conventions**: Streamlit app injects heavy CSS in [backend/app.py](../backend/app.py) and `views/utils.py` to enforce white/black theme and bubble styling—preserve selectors when editing. Frontend uses Tailwind v4 and Radix components; follow existing classnames and layout patterns.
- **Stateful storage**: Backend session data persists via SQLite files; do not hardcode absolute paths—use helpers in `services/utils.py`. Frontend expects snake_case columns (Drizzle `casing: "snake_case"`).
- **Logging/observability**: Orchestrator and services print progress to stdout; caching prints paths. Keep informative prints for long LLM steps.
- **Testing/validation**: Only scripted check is `python test_refactored_code.py` (imports/paths). No JS tests present; run `npm run lint` for frontend static checks.
- **Data safety**: Inputs and outputs are medical-coding specific; when prompting LLMs, include audit window via `compute_audit_window()` and avoid inventing CPT codes. Preserve XML-style tags if touching legacy comprehensive prompt parsing.

If any section needs more detail or feels ambiguous, tell me which part to expand (backend workflow, frontend auth, RAG build, etc.).
